Touhou Mystia's Izakaya splits the world of Gensokyo into several smaller '''locations'''. The basegame contains 5 larger areas (alongside the far smaller [[Hakugyokurou]]), while each DLC adds 2 more areas, for a total of 16 different locations. Areas usually contain 3 [https://touhou-mystias-izakaya.fandom.com/wiki/Customers#Rare_Customers Rare Customers] each, [[merchants]], and gathering locations, while some may house additional interactable elements.

== Day ==
Mystia starts her day inside her house, a subarea of [[Youkai Trail]], and can head to other areas from there. The player can either directly walk from one place to another by using exits in certain parts of each location, or pull up the map and fast travel to the area. Each screen transition takes up 30 minutes of the day section regardless of method. Certain locations ([[Hakugyokurou]], the [[Shining Needle Castle]], and the Lunar Capital) can only be accessed via fast travel - traveling to and from them takes 30 minutes, regardless of where the player is or where they are headed. Once the player gains access to such an area, they can use them to go from one place to another in at most one hour.

Alternatively, after donating a total of 25500 yen to the [[Hakurei Shrine]] donation box, a new form of travel becomes accessible. The player may travel between locations without spending time, in exchange for spending 100 yen for every area they travel this way (thus spending 100 yen for 30 minutes of saved time).

== Night ==
Once the day section ends, the player returns to the map and selects a location (except [[Hakugyokurou]], which is inaccesible for this period) to set up shop at, alongside an izakaya level of their choice. Each area houses different normal Customers, Rare Customers, has a different appearance and has unique background music.
